study: development-selected mixed-appearance visual transition model with later frozen same-app checks

model.eval_source: Primary light-theme archive only; the additional dark archive contributed fit and validation rows, not eval rows.

selection_history: Scale powers 0, 0.5, 0.75, and 1 were inspected on earlier same-app light/dark evaluations. The 0.75 candidate was frozen before two new 20-pair evaluation archives were collected. This is development selection, not an independent environment-blind benchmark.
capture_note: Fresh headless browser storage; same-origin HTTP and WebSocket restrictions; decorative canvas and telemetry hidden; no raw screenshots retained. The earlier dark fit report used the split-basis label viewport_family_and_theme even though that particular capture was dark for all six families; the collector label was corrected afterward. Its rows remained viewport-family partitioned.
interpretation: One app and two deterministic navigation choices show an action-conditioned signal across light and dark appearances under small viewport variations. The 20 groups in each fresh set are not independent applications or tasks. This does not validate multi-step planning, open-world desktop transfer, calibrated uncertainty, safe execution, or Jev parity. Research weights remain ignored local files and are not loaded into the live UiJepaPredictor.
